recipes.caption: Every Grow a Garden recipe, with exact ingredient counts, what gates it and what it produces

rows.name: Ice Cream

cells.Ingredients with exact quantities: 2 crops. 1x cone crop (Cauliflower, Corn, Banana, Violet Corn or Sugarglaze) plus 1x sweet crop. Worked: 1x Corn plus 1x Blueberry
cells.Unlock requirement: Cooking Kit, claimed from the Garden Guide achievement sets
cells.Output value: Base cook time 5 minutes at base weight 2kg. Rarity rises with rarer and heavier crops

rows.requirements: Cooking Kit, claimed from the Garden Guide achievement sets
rows.notes: Two outlets and the wiki agree on a cone crop plus one sweet crop. No publisher channel states the recipe.

rows.name: Sushi

cells.Ingredients with exact quantities: 4 crops. 1x Bamboo plus 1x leafy crop plus 1x vegetable crop plus 1x rice crop (Cauliflower, Corn, Banana, Violet Corn or Sugarglaze). Worked: 4x Bamboo plus 1x Corn
cells.Unlock requirement: Cooking Kit, plus Bamboo from the Seed Shop rotation
cells.Output value: Base cook time 5 minutes at base weight 2kg. Rarity rises with rarer and heavier crops

rows.requirements: Cooking Kit, plus Bamboo from the Seed Shop rotation
rows.notes: Every recorded Sushi recipe contains Bamboo and a corn family crop. Sources disagree above Divine.

rows.name: Soup

cells.Ingredients with exact quantities: Any combination that is not a recipe for another food. There is no Soup recipe to discover
cells.Unlock requirement: Cooking Kit, claimed from the Garden Guide achievement sets
cells.Output value: Base cook time 5 minutes at base weight 0.5kg. Soup is the fallback output, not a target

rows.requirements: Cooking Kit, claimed from the Garden Guide achievement sets
rows.notes: Beebom and the wiki both describe Soup as the fallback for an unrecognised combination.

cells.Unlock requirement: Cooking Kit, claimed from the Garden Guide achievement sets

unverified_summary: No row on this page is publisher confirmed, so every row displays as Unverified and the active count is zero. Grow a Garden publishes no recipe list on any channel it controls, and the ingredient counts here come from two independent outlets cross checked against the community wiki. Base cook times and base weights come from the wiki alone and no outlet repeats them, so treat those figures as the weakest data on the page. The seasonal foods the wiki documents, including Candy Cane, Eggnog, Fruitcake, Gingerbread Cookie, Holiday Roast, Holiday Stuffing and Wreath, are left out because no second source covers them and their crops are not in the current Seed Shop rotation.

disagreements.item: Divine Ice Cream from 3x Sugar Apple plus 1x Corn
disagreements.source_a: Beebom lists it as a plain Divine recipe
disagreements.source_b: PCGamesN lists it as Divine only while Chris P. is craving Ice Cream, and the wiki files the same combination under Prismatic craving only
disagreements.confirmed: Not confirmed. Cravings left with the event NPC, so the tier all three describe cannot be reproduced.

disagreements.source_a: Beebom lists 1x Corn plus 1x Bamboo plus 1x Elder Strawberry plus 2x Bone Blossom
disagreements.source_b: The wiki lists 1x Corn plus 1x Bamboo plus 3x Bone Blossom, and PCGamesN calls that same combination Divine while also stating no Prismatic Sushi recipe has been found
disagreements.confirmed: Not confirmed. The base of Bamboo plus a corn family crop is agreed. The Bone Blossom count is not.

disagreements.item: How many Cooking Kits one garden holds
disagreements.source_a: TheGamer reports that three can be placed at once
disagreements.source_b: The wiki states no limit at all
disagreements.confirmed: Not confirmed. No publisher channel states a cap.

disagreements.source_a: Beebom states cooking takes at least five minutes
disagreements.source_b: The wiki food list gives per dish base times from one minute to eight minutes
disagreements.confirmed: Not confirmed. The per dish figures contradict a flat five minute floor.

disagreements.source_a: The wiki lists it in the Cosmetics Shop for 1,000,000
disagreements.source_b: Beebom and TheGamer describe only the Garden Guide achievement route
disagreements.confirmed: Not confirmed. The achievement route is corroborated twice. The shop price is single sourced.

fakes.claim: A Transcendent Sandwich, Sushi or Burger recipe
fakes.why_wrong: The largest recipe table in circulation records no recipe found at Transcendent for all three, and no second source produces one. Any exact list you are shown was filled in rather than tested.
fakes.origin: Aggregator posts and compilation videos that copy a recipe table and complete its blank cells.

fakes.why_wrong: Soup is the fallback output for any combination the game does not recognise as another food. There is nothing to discover, and a Soup you did not want means your slots did not match a real recipe.
fakes.origin: Video thumbnails promising a hidden Soup combination.

fakes.claim: Craving only recipes presented as current
fakes.why_wrong: Chris P. and the craving system left with the Cooking Event. Every recipe still marked craving only, or that promises a one tier upgrade, describes a mechanic that is no longer in the experience.
fakes.origin: Event era guides that were never revised after the NPC was removed.

fakes.claim: Ice cream needs a milk or cream crop
fakes.why_wrong: The cream slot takes any sweet crop. There is no dairy crop in Grow a Garden, so any list naming one is describing a crop that does not exist.
fakes.origin: Recipe pages written from real world cooking rather than from the game.

fakes.claim: A live Cooking Event calendar stamped with the current year
fakes.why_wrong: The Cooking Event ran once and closed. Pages restamping its calendar with a fresh year are re dating old copy, not reporting a live event.
fakes.origin: Content farms that regenerate an old guide with a new date to look updated.

changes.what: Cooking Event opened in Update 1.17.0 with the lobby pot, Chris P. and the Rat Connoisseur
Event closed, Chris P. and cravings removed, and cooking made permanent through the Cooking Kit
Corndog added, and tied to crafting the Pet Pouch
Recipes documented as fixed crop slots with per dish base cook times and base weights
Page first published with every recipe, both removed event mechanics and five source conflicts

next_change.pattern: Food changes arrive with seasonal events rather than on a fixed schedule, and the crop groups behind each slot shift whenever the Seed Shop rotation changes.
